title: Real-Time Influenza Surveillance Using DeepSeek-Augmented BERT Classification on Chinese Social Media: Infodemiology Study.
summary: Social-media classifier produced an influenza signal leading the official series by about a week; first-version and final results support that limited claim.
ai_technology: LLM pseudo-labeling plus chronological BERT test set; index correlations with CDC ILI and lead-time analysis reported; no lab confirmation or multi-season test.

evidence.tested: Validation basis and its limits: LLM pseudo-labeling plus chronological BERT test set; index correlations with CDC ILI and lead-time analysis reported; no lab confirmation or multi-season test.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
